I've only  just purchased this and begin going thru the set up process for next year. It's already an improvement from the Excel file I've been using which cost me $40 (outside of Etsy). That one only allows a certain of customizable account lines, with over 40 pre-programmed accounts which are not applicable to our small business. This workbook allows 40 account categories (could use maybe 10 more-I switched from a much more expensive software which had become faaaar to expensive for our business which is winding down to my  husband's retirement), but they are all completely customizable. No data entry yet, but hopefully it will suffice for our needs. Still need to see how reconciling bank accounts will be...if it's built in. So far, I can recommend.
